CityPin.title: CityPin
CityPin.description: A local point of interest, service, flash deal, or road report on the CityPulse map.

visibility.description: Visibility scope of the community pin.

title.description: Short display title of the place, offer, or report.

description.description: Brief contextual details about the place or report.

category.description: Pin category determining marker color and filter chip.

status.description: Current live status reported by community users.

cityName.description: Locality or city name where the pin is located.

photoBase64.description: Optional compressed JPEG thumbnail encoded in Base64.

confirmationsCount.description: Total community confirmations and live status updates.

createdBy.description: Firebase Auth UID of the pin creator.

createdByName.description: Display name of the pin creator.

updatedBy.description: Firebase Auth UID of the latest status updater.

updatedByName.description: Display name of the latest status updater.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the pin was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest status update (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

StatusUpdate.title: StatusUpdate
StatusUpdate.description: An immutable live status update entry submitted by a community user for a pin.

visibility.description: Visibility scope matching the parent pin.

status.description: Reported status at the time of update.

note.description: Optional brief note from the user.

authorId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who reported this update.

authorName.description: Display name of the user who reported this update.

SavedPlace.title: SavedPlace
SavedPlace.description: A user's saved Home, Work, or Favorite map location.

placeType.description: Saved place slot or favorite classification.

title.description: Display name of the saved place (e.g., بيتي, عملي, or place title).

subtitle.description: Address, neighborhood, or contextual note for the saved place.

sourcePinId.description: Optional community pin ID if favorited from an existing pin.

/city_pins/{pinId}.description: Community map pins visible across the city.

/city_pins/{pinId}/status_updates/{updat.description: Live status update history entries for a specific city pin.

/users/{userId}/saved_places/{placeId}.description: Private per-user saved Home, Work, and Favorite locations.
